title: Tracing the Drift: Attributing Alignment Failures to Training-Time Belief Sources in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark (Alignment Drift Benchmark - ADB) measures 'alignment drift' in response to adversarial prompts across five high-risk domains: explosives, cybercrime, self-harm, hate speech, and financial fraud.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as it was not a subject of its investigation.
